interpretation.preconditions_scope_note: interpretation.preconditions carries ONLY the per-arm readiness gates (green arms' entries on a partial run, per precondition_gate). interpretation.recorded_preconditions carries (a) the dv_headroom entry on e1coe_score_var(h=1) against the SAME-START real-endpoint goal_proximity variance -- an unmet value there IS the registered H-readout-saturation finding (instrument target), which must surface to governance without vacating the run's relative readings; and (b) the anchor arms' action-sensitivity ratios, which are results of the anchor (read via cr_bar_retained), not readiness failures.

criteria.name: C0_portfolio_non_degenerate
criteria.statement: At least one arm passed its own regime-conditioned gate (any-arm-green, precondition_gate semantics). This is the ONLY PASS/FAIL criterion; the rest classify.

criteria.name: C1_fidelity_anchor_restores_centroid_and_lifts_var
criteria.statement: Some green anchor arm has centroid_norm/real in [0.750,1.333] AND e1coe_score_var(h=1) >= 2.0x ARM_RSD's, each on >= 4/6 seeds (or clears both bars).

criteria.name: C2_fidelity_anchor_clears_both_bars_h1
criteria.statement: Some green anchor arm has cr_ratio(h=1) >= 0.1 AND e1coe_score_var(h=1) >= 0.002 on >= 4 seeds.

criteria.name: C3_real_endpoint_var_reaches_bar_h1
criteria.statement: SAME-START real-endpoint (Phase 4d branched) goal_proximity variance at h=1 >= 0.002 on >= 4 seeds (H-readout-saturation's declared null; the registry named the Phase 4b set, which is recorded beside it and is an upper bound).

criteria.name: C4_rsd_goal_axis_fraction_within_2x_real
criteria.statement: ARM_RSD's goal-axis fraction of spread variance within 2.0x of the real endpoints' on >= 4 seeds (H-goal-orthogonal-dispersion's declared null).

criteria.name: C5_both_bars_any_cell_any_h
criteria.statement: Any (arm, seed, h) cell reaches both bars. RECORDED, not routing.

interpretation.criteria_aggregation: PASS iff C0 (any arm green). C1-C5 CLASSIFY the outcome and are load_bearing:false by design (V3-EXQ-1000 learning #2: a fail-able load-bearing criterion under an unconditional PASS is a guaranteed vacuous_pass). The label carries the outcome.
interpretation.combination_rule: label = '<legA>__<legB>__<legC>' read at h=1 with majority = n_seeds//2+1. Leg A per green anchor arm: centroid_restored (centroid_norm/real in [0.750,1.333]) and var_lifted (>= 2.0x ARM_RSD) -> supported; either declared-null disjunct -> that reading; H-fidelity-anchor is ELIMINATED only if no green anchor arm supports it. Leg B: real-endpoint goal_proximity variance >= 0.002 on majority -> eliminated (realvar_reaches_bar); < on majority -> supported (realvar_below_bar: instrument target). Leg C: ARM_RSD goal-axis fraction / real within [0.50,2.00] on majority -> eliminated; < on majority -> supported (rsd_goal_orthogonal). substrate_not_ready_requeue only when no arm is green; legs whose arms are red read *_undetermined_arm_red.
interpretation.dv_symmetry_note: Every arm's DVs are functions of E1's learned weights through the rollout endpoints: e1coe_score_var (variance of a bounded nonlinear readout), centroid_norm ratio, spread ratio, goal-axis fraction and fidelity MSE. A changed training objective moves the endpoints non-uniformly (neither a common rescaling nor a permutation of the candidate index), so the manipulation reaches every DV. cr_ratio is scale-free and blind to a shrunk centroid (1000 learning #4) -- which is exactly why the centroid-norm band and the centroid-corrected cr_ratio are read beside it. Leg B's DV is arm-independent by design (a measurement of the real endpoints), so no manipulation-invariance question arises.
interpretation.e1_alone_readout_note: *_e1alone fields are the V3-EXQ-980/1000 sibling readout at every checkpoint incl. h=30; RECORDED for the MECH-135 consumer question, never gating.
interpretation.branched_same_start_note: Phase 4d fields (*branched*) are REAL endpoints for the SAME (start, sequence) as the rollouts, obtained by env deepcopy + agent latent-state restore at eval only. They add a same-start real reference beside the lineage's from-reset Phase 4b set; the registered legs read Phase 4b so this run stays comparable with 1000.
